Omar Haddad: Hey folks—need advice. Im EU-based (Germany) and have 4 days carryover from last year. Im booked for Dec 30-Jan 2 for family care, but Dec 30-31 fall in our year-end blackout. Can we get an exception or swap with a national holiday?
Sofia (People Ops): Hi Omar, sorry for the timing. For EU teams we normally treat statutory public holidays separately from the company PTO blackout. If any of those dates are German public holidays they remain holidays. For the blackout-covered days you can request a "Carryover Exception for Medical/Family Care" or a floating holiday swap if you have floating days left.
Omar Haddad: Dec 31 is a public holiday here (Silvester), Dec 30 is not. I have one floating holiday unused. Could I swap the floating to Dec 30 and use public holiday code for Dec 31 so none of it hits my PTO?
Priya (Manager): Im ok approving the floating holiday swap for Omar. No delivery impact. Approving here.
Lena (Payroll): Quick payroll note: For Germany, public holiday -> paid leave and not deducted from PTO. Floating holiday swap is fine but payroll needs People Ops to flag the swap so we can post the FloatingHoliday paycode. If carryover is used we need to know whether to treat it as "exception carryover" so it bypasses blackout rules.
Sofia (People Ops): Process: 1) Manager approval in thread (done). 2) Omar file the "Floating Holiday Swap" form and select "Return/accommodation or blackout exception" if prompted. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/floating-swap (internal). 3) We will mark Dec 30 as FloatingHoliday and Dec 31 as PublicHoliday. If you still want Dec 30 as carryover instead, we can mark it as "Exception Carryover" but need a short reason (family care) + any supporting doc if medical.
Omar Haddad: Id prefer the swap so I keep my carryover for early Jan if needed. Filing the form now.
HR-Bot: Ticket HR-2026-4982 created for Omar Haddad  please attach the floating-swap form or reply here once submitted.
Omar Haddad: Form submitted and I attached a short note 'family care appointment'—no medical docs required. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/req/FH-2026-210
Lena (Payroll): Received. People Ops  please flag as "Accommodation - Floating Swap" so payroll can post the code. ETA 2 business days after flag. For EU payroll, swapping a floating holiday may affect local payroll reporting; payroll will handle reporting but please confirm the employee will remain in Germany for payroll period (no cross-border travel).
Sofia (People Ops): Flagging HR-2026-4982 as "Approved - Floating Swap" and noting manager approver Priya. Omar, well bypass the blackout for Dec 30.
Nadia (Legal): Quick compliance note: keep the audit entry with manager approval and rationale. If Omar works remotely from another country during those days, we need to re-run payroll/residency checks.
Omar Haddad: Ill be in Germany the whole time. Thanks everyone for the quick help. :relieved:
Priya (Manager): Thanks team. Glad we could sort it.
Lena (Payroll): Posting will happen in next payroll batch  Ill update the ticket when posted.
HR-Bot: HR-2026-4982 updated  Payroll posted FloatingHoliday code for Dec 30 and PublicHoliday for Dec 31. Ticket closed.
Omar Haddad: I see the update in my accruals  all good. Thanks! :thumbsup:
